title: Dedicated capacity rapid stabilization and retrospective
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Urgent ticket to document the emergency steps taken to stabilize a dedicated capacity shortfall that started 2025-02-17 23:40 UTC, capture root cause hypotheses, and track actionable remediation and platform hardening. Focus areas: temporary stabilization, autoscaler regression containment, enhanced telemetry for headroom detection, and follow-on engineering deliverables to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2025-02-17 23:40 UTC: First user reports elevated latencies from customers on dedicated pools via #ops-dedicated-capacity.
2025-02-17 23:55 UTC: On-call rotated into SRE war room, correlated error spike with sustained decrease in available slots in pool eu-west-1-dedicated.
2025-02-18 00:10 UTC: Emergency heuristic throttle applied to non-critical routes to preserve headroom; canary fallback to smaller models enabled for tiered customers.
2025-02-18 01:05 UTC: Identified autoscaler decision loop triggered by new scheduler change (PR #4773) that lowered scale aggressiveness under high-variance signal.
2025-02-18 02:30 UTC: Temporary manual scale-up of affected pools and activation of burst-pool offload completed; 95th percentile latency returned to acceptable SLOs.
2025-02-18 10:00 UTC: Incident bridge closed; created follow-up engineering work and postmortem doc linked below.
decisions: Apply an immediate revert of scheduler change PR #4773 from main -> hotfix branch; roll forward after additional telemetry gating.
Introduce 'safety_headroom_tokens' abstraction: reserve configurable slot % per pool to prevent full depletion during noisy bursts.
Change autoscaler policy to use median+MAD signal with 90s aggregation window to reduce oscillation from short spikes.
Enrich capacity telemetry with 'effective_headroom_pct' and 'autoscaler_confidence' to feed alerting and automated circuit breakers.
mitigation_steps: Hotfix: reverted scheduler PR and redeployed 2025-02-18 03:00 UTC (PR #4821).
Manual scale: +30% capacity added to eu-west-1-dedicated for 3 hours to restore headroom.
Route-level graceful degradation: engaged route fallback mapping to smaller quantized model variants for non-P0 customers.
Enabled burst-pool offload for long-tail tenant jobs to reduce queue pressure on dedicated pools.
action_items: ENG-208712: Implement safety_headroom_tokens and expose per-pool config in control plane — owner: Liam Chen — due: 2025-03-14
ENG-208713: Add 'effective_headroom_pct' metric to Grafana and to alerting runbooks — owner: Priya Nair — due: 2025-03-07
ENG-208714: Create synthetic steady-state and pulse load tests in CI to validate autoscaler behavior across variance profiles — owner: Marco Ortega — due: 2025-03-21
ENG-208715: Add canary gating for scheduler changes with rollback criteria and automated revert PRs — owner: Aisha Kapoor — due: 2025-03-28
ENG-208716: Postmortem writeup in Confluence and customer communications template — owner: Sarah Bloom — due: 2025-03-04
notes: Root cause likely a regression in scheduler decision thresholds combined with a recent change that reduced autoscaler aggressiveness; final RCA pending.
We observed autoscaler confidence dropping before capacity drained, implying insufficient signal weighting for predictive headroom.
Follow-ups prioritize deterministic tests, safer default headroom, and faster automated rollback on regressions.
